XE should be tracked as a newly listed fuel-fabrication/advanced-reactor hybrid; market may focus on SMR deployments while TRISO-X fuel fabrication is the more node-specific chokepoint.

node: Nuclear fuel-cycle bottlenecks: conversion, enrichment, HALEU, and fuel fabrication
summary: Layer 1B expands the investable universe around the nuclear fuel-cycle processing bottleneck rather than uranium mining. The strongest direct public-market mapping is Centrus Energy for U.S. HALEU/enrichment. Cameco is the reference conversion/fuel-services anchor. X-energy is a newly public advanced-reactor/fuel-fabrication name with direct TRISO-X HALEU fuel-fabrication exposure but early public-market history. ASP Isotopes is a speculative shadow candidate: it has public TerraPower-linked HALEU facility and supply agreements, but the technology, licensing, financing, and execution evidence need much stricter verification before it can survive later Serenity layers.
